name: Ontology Registry Activation CLI & Scenario Proof
description: Expose the internal ontology registry activation lifecycle via local qa-sdk CLI, resolve known packs, run local SQLite-backed activation, emit machine-readable JSON, and prove programming-artifact and authorization ontology scenarios.

userStories.title: Discover Pack Sources and CLI Runtime Boundary
userStories.description: As a CLI maintainer, I want known ontology pack sources and local runtime boundaries documented so the activation command does not guess imports or storage behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm `operational-ontology-registry-allocation.spec.md` states Phase 5 internal lifecycle is complete and this CLI is an optional public/local execution surface, not a new lifecycle phase.
Identify known pack ids supported by the CLI: at least `programming-artifact-ontology` and `authorization-ontology`.
Add `authorization-ontology` as a CLI dependency if required.
Document the local SQLite runtime strategy for registry-service/index-meta stores.
Confirm command path and flags before implementation.
Do not implement the command in this story.

userStories.title: Add Known Pack Resolver
userStories.description: As a CLI user, I want the activation command to resolve stable pack ids so I can activate known ontology packs without writing custom JSON fixtures.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a CLI-local known pack resolver for `programming-artifact-ontology`.
Add a CLI-local known pack resolver for `authorization-ontology`.
Unknown pack id returns a structured error listing supported pack ids.
Resolver does not import test fixtures.
Resolver can be unit tested without creating SQLite stores.

userStories.title: Build Local Activation Runtime
userStories.description: As a CLI maintainer, I want a local activation runtime so the CLI can call the internal activation helper without requiring a running registry-service server.
acceptanceCriteria: Add helper code to construct registry-service ontology store, prefix registry, schema version store, sync adapter, service, and activation helper for a local SQLite path.
Support `--store <path>` for persistent local SQLite state.
Support an in-memory/test runtime if useful for tests.
Runtime reuses existing registry-service store and index-meta APIs.
Runtime does not start a Nest HTTP server.
Runtime does not add REST API calls.

userStories.title: Add ontology registry activate-pack Command
userStories.description: As a CLI user, I want a command to activate a known ontology pack so I can run the internal lifecycle from the terminal.
acceptanceCriteria: Add command descriptor for `qa-sdk ontology registry activate-pack <pack-id>`.
Support prefix overrides for taxonomy ids using a deterministic flag shape, for example `--prefix <taxonomyId>=<prefix>`.
Command does not reimplement activation lifecycle logic.

userStories.title: Define JSON Output and Error Contract
userStories.description: As an automation user, I want stable JSON output so activation results can be consumed by agents, tests, and future artifact workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: `--json` emits the activation result payload from the helper.
Failure output includes structured failed activation result when helper returns one.
Unknown pack and invalid CLI flag errors produce JSON when `--json` is present.
Raw SQL errors are not exposed in JSON output.
Non-JSON output is concise and includes status, pack id, allocation count, smoke summary, and action hints.

userStories.title: Prove Programming Artifact Ontology Activation Scenario
userStories.description: As an ontology maintainer, I want the CLI to activate programming-artifact ontology so that artifact vocabulary allocation is proven through the real command path.
acceptanceCriteria: Add CLI test invoking `ontology registry activate-pack programming-artifact-ontology --json`.
Test uses isolated temporary SQLite store.
Output includes allocation summaries for programming artifact kind/relation taxonomy surfaces.
Output includes successful sync summaries and smoke checks.
Re-running the same command against the same store is idempotent or returns the documented structured failure if activation is not intended to be idempotent.

userStories.title: Prove Authorization Ontology Activation Scenario
userStories.description: As an ontology maintainer, I want the CLI to activate authorization ontology so that a real domain ontology pack is proven through the activation lifecycle.
acceptanceCriteria: Add CLI test invoking `ontology registry activate-pack authorization-ontology --json`.
Test uses isolated temporary SQLite store.
Output includes authorization ontology allocation summaries.
Output includes successful sync summaries and smoke checks.
The test validates that known authorization ontology axes/taxonomies are represented in activation output.

userStories.title: Prove CLI Failure Scenarios
userStories.description: As a CLI user, I want predictable failure output so automation can distinguish bad input, lifecycle conflicts, and drift.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown pack id returns a structured error and non-zero exit code.
Invalid `--address-model` returns a structured error and non-zero exit code.
Duplicate prefix/version or drift scenario returns activation result with `status: "failed"` and structured errors.
Failure output does not expose raw SQL.
Tests cover JSON and non-JSON failure output where practical.

userStories.title: Optionally Persist Activation Result Output
userStories.description: As an automation user, I want to save activation results to a file so that later workflows can inspect activation evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `--output <file>` support if it fits existing CLI output conventions.
Saved output is the same JSON payload emitted by `--json`.
Parent directories are created as needed.
This story does not append to programming artifact registry yet.
If `--output` is deferred, document the reason and leave a follow-up TODO.

userStories.title: Reflect CLI Surface in Docs and TODO
userStories.description: As an ontology documentation maintainer, I want the activation CLI reflected in specs and TODO so the next scenario-proof work starts from current behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update CLI spec documentation for `ontology registry activate-pack`.
Update `operational-ontology-registry-allocation.spec.md` to mention CLI activation surface.
Update `operational-ontology-registry-allocation.todo.md` if public CLI exposure closes a tracked gap.
Update programming-artifact/authorization scenario docs only if tests prove those scenarios.
Keep REST API exposure and artifact registry persistence as follow-up work.
